code='''from collections import Counter\n\ndef transform(grid):\n    """Move the non-background pattern down by one row, preserving canvas size."""\n    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])\n    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]\n    out = [[bg for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]\n    for r in range(h - 1):\n        for c, value in enumerate(grid[r]):\n            if value != bg:\n                out[r + 1][c] = value\n    return out\n'''
